item.title: Makara Roel Memorial, AI Scam Warnings, Dog Owner Plea

item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, a grieving North Andros community gathers to celebrate the extraordinary life and faith of a young victim lost in the tragic Independence Day plane crash. We investigate an early morning shooting in Nichollstown and bring you a long-awaited update from the Health Minister on the administrative backlog affecting hundreds of public health nurses. Security experts reveal how artificial intelligence is fueling a new wave of sophisticated local scams, while the Bahamas Humane Society issues a blunt wake-up call to pet owners following a string of violent dog attacks. Plus, we bring you the latest highlights from our Bahamian sports stars and a vibrant look at the musical rhythms of Barbados' Crop Over festival.
